We're getting our AP queue set up for Redwood and I want to confirm how we'll receive invoices going forward. A couple of notes from our side: 

- Company name: Acme Tech, VAT: GB123456789 (EU/UK VAT registered)
- PO: ACME-PO-4456 (please include on invoice line items)
- Preferred delivery: we can accept either portal ingestion (preferred long-term) or invoice PDFs emailed to accounts-payable@acme-tech.com. If using email, we need PDF attachments that include line-item breakdown and VAT.

2) A stub PDF for the most recent invoice so we can confirm totals and VAT fields

- Long term: we can push invoices to Acme's billing portal. To do that I need the portal admin contact (Joel) and the desired billing owner on your side. We support SFTP ingestion or API-based delivery into most portals; if you have a portal vendor name I can confirm the exact flow.

Action items for Redwood: 
- I will attach a billing setup guide with the fields we need (company name, VAT, billing address, preferred remittance). (attachment: acct_setup_instructions.pdf)
- I will attach a stub copy of the June invoice for your review. (attachment: Invoice_2026-06-ACME_stub.pdf)

Can you confirm: 1) confirm Joel Park (joel.park@acme-tech.com) as portal admin, and 2) that we should email the next two invoices to accounts-payable@acme-tech.com during onboarding? Once Joel confirms, Monica (cc’d) from our billing team will kick off portal provisioning and send the DocuSign for billing-owner consent if required.

Best,
